Telemedicine from Texas

Dr. Ehsan sees patients by video this week and is not at the California offices. Your clinic will tell you how to join.

To book, confirm, cancel or change an appointment, please call your clinic. This website and Dr. Ehsan’s social media cannot schedule visits, and messages there are not monitored for medical care. Please don’t send personal health information here.

Emergency? Call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

About Dr. Ehsan

Board certified

  • Medical OncologyAmerican Board of Internal Medicine
  • Internal MedicineAmerican Board of Internal Medicine

Dr. Alex Ehsan is a physician and medical educator in internal medicine, hematology and oncology. He practices at Starling Oncology (formerly The Oncology Institute) in Downey and Culver City, California.

He created this free website so patients and families can understand their care, feel less lost, and walk into appointments with the right questions.

Hospital affiliations include Palmdale Regional Medical Center, PIH Health Downey Hospital, PIH Health Whittier Hospital, Providence Holy Cross Medical Center, Northridge Hospital Medical Center and Henry Mayo Newhall Hospital. Member, American College of Physicians.
